newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Two killed, over 40 injured in Australian bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Two killed, over 40 injured in Australian bus crash.

text.p: Two people were killed and more than 40 injured early on Tuesday when an Australian bus slammed into a roadside embankment and overturned, police said.

The bus with about 50 passengers crashed on a straight section of highway four kilometres (2.5 miles) north of the town of Tenterfield in northern New South Wales. Police said a man and a boy had been killed and more than 40 passengers had been taken to Tenterfield hospital after the early-morning crash.

The northern New South Wales region has become notorious for bus crashes, with 55 killed in two accidents on highways there in two months in 1989. The crashes triggered law changes which forced many bus operators to install seat belts.
